# Cook what you've got tonight


Imagine an AI that learns your pantry and fridge, then invents dinner using only what you already own. With NVIDIA ChatRTX you can do exactly that—no extra shopping, no waste, and no recipe books. This beginner-friendly guide walks you through the whole process in under ten minutes.

## Before you start
- A Windows PC with an NVIDIA RTX graphics card (20-series or newer).
- NVIDIA ChatRTX installed (free download from NVIDIA's site).
- A short list of ingredients you already have (tinned tomatoes, pasta, cheese, etc.).
- Rough time: 8–10 minutes.

---

## Step 1 — Install NVIDIA ChatRTX

Open your web browser and go to the official NVIDIA ChatRTX page. If available, look for a download button in the top-right area of the page. Click it, then run the installer. When the installer finishes, open the Windows Start menu and type **ChatRTX** to launch the app. You'll see a small window with a chat interface. You'll know it worked when the interface loads and you can type a message.

💬 Example:
`Open your browser, go to NVIDIA's ChatRTX page, click the download button, run the installer, then open the Start menu and type "ChatRTX".`

---

## Step 2 — Load your own recipe file

Inside ChatRTX, look for an option to add your own documents or knowledge base. The exact button or menu name may vary by version. Click it and choose a simple text file on your computer that lists recipes you like. If you don't have one, create a plain text file on your desktop and add three or four recipes you enjoy (one per line). After you pick the file, wait for a confirmation message. You'll know it worked when you see the file listed somewhere in the interface.

💬 Example:
Create a text file on the desktop with your favorite recipes, like:
```
Spaghetti Bolognese
Chicken Stir-fry
Vegetable Soup
```
Then in ChatRTX, use the document loading feature to add this file.

---

## Step 3 — Teach the AI your ingredients

Still in ChatRTX, use the same document loading feature to add a second file that lists every ingredient you have right now. In that file, list items like pasta, tinned tomatoes, onion, cheese. ChatRTX will show a confirmation when the file is processed. You'll know it worked when the ingredients list appears in the interface as a knowledge source you can reference.

💬 Example:
Create a text file on your desktop with:
```
pasta
tinned tomatoes
onion
cheese
olive oil
```
Then in ChatRTX, load this file as a second knowledge source.

---

## Step 4 — Ask for a recipe that only uses your pantry

In the chat interface, type: "Give me a dinner recipe using only ingredients from my pantry." ChatRTX will reply with a short recipe that only uses items from your list. You'll know it worked when the reply shows a recipe using only the ingredients you provided.

💬 Example:
`Give me a dinner recipe using only ingredients from my pantry.`

---

## Step 5 — Refine the recipe if needed

If the recipe isn't quite right, type a follow-up like "Can you make it vegetarian?" or "Use less cheese." ChatRTX will adjust the recipe on the fly. You'll know it worked when the new version appears in the chat with updated ingredients and instructions.

💬 Example:
`Can you make it vegetarian?`

---

## Step 6 — Save the recipe to your phone

Highlight the recipe text in the chat, copy it (Ctrl+C), open the Notes app on your phone, and paste (long-press → paste). Label the note "Tonight's dinner." You'll know it worked when the recipe is saved and ready to cook.

💬 Example:
Copy the whole reply, open Notes on your phone, paste, and title it "Tonight's dinner".

---

## Common mistakes
- **Mistake:** You load the wrong file and ChatRTX can't find the recipes.
  **Fix:** Double-check that your recipe file is properly loaded and appears in the interface before asking for recipes.

- **Mistake:** The AI suggests an ingredient you don't have.
  **Fix:** Reply with "Remove the cheese" or "Use only what's in my pantry" and ChatRTX will adjust.

- **Mistake:** The chat interface doesn't appear after install.
  **Fix:** Restart your PC and open ChatRTX from the Start menu again.

---

## What this means for you
- **In everyday life:** Keep a text file with your pantry items on your desktop and update it whenever you shop. Next time you're stuck, ask ChatRTX for a dinner idea—no extra ingredients, no waste, and no last-minute dash to the shops.
- **For your business or work:** Use the same trick to generate quick snack ideas for office lunches or client gifts, cutting food waste and saving money.
- **If you're just getting started:** Start with a single recipe file and a five-item pantry list. Once you see how easy it is, you'll build bigger collections over time.

---
## Try it now

Open **ChatRTX**, load a text file with one recipe you like, and create a second text file with three items you already own. Ask for a dinner recipe using only those items. Copy the result to your phone and cook it tonight.
